description: Read-only automatic project routing and pre-edit reminders.

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'route_dir="$PWD"; while :; do for route_script in "$route_dir/Operations/CodexHooks/context.py" "$route_dir/AIRoot/Operations/CodexHooks/context.py"; do if [ -f "$route_script" ]; then exec /usr/bin/python3 "$route_script"; fi; done; [ "$route_dir" = / ] && break; route_dir=$(dirname "$route_dir"); done; echo "Codex routing hook: helper missing; load AGENTS.md" >&2; exit 1'
